title: Lok's Leadership/Quotes
summary:
"I've come to see the Master. Hope the old rascal's managed to stay alive after all these years."
- Dante Vale to Lin Storm

"Lok, I'm glad to see you taking your responsibilities seriously."
- Metz to Lok Lambert

"How is my old friend, Metz? Still a ladykiller and a daredevil?"
- Master Storm to Dante Vale

"What's wrong? Think the throne's trapped?" (Harrison Fears)

"A throne is no place for sneaky tricks. It's the center of power." (Zhalia Moon)

"With the Blood Spirals, I'm going to bring everyone on Earth the same pain and loneliness we felt as orphans. You'll never stop us!"
- Harrison Fears to Den Fears

"You seek the strength and wisdom to change fate?" (Master Storm)

"No. I just want to meet it. Head on." (Dante Vale)

"This is a vampire's castle. It's customary to enter with burning torches." (Dante Vale)
